title: The EZ SQL Reports Shortcode Widget and DB Backup plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting…
description: The EZ SQL Reports Shortcode Widget and DB Backup plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in all versions up to and including 5.26.45. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping of the User-Agent header, which is stored in the comment_agent field. An unauthenticated attacker can inject malicious scripts that execute when a user accesses a page containing the injected report. Exploitation requires that an administrator saves a report with an SQL query selecting attacker-controlled data such as comment_agent and that the attacker knows the report's slug, which is easily obtained if the report is published publicly via the [SQLREPORT] shortcode.
